routes.name: Varzia relics, as Carrier Prime
routes.cost: 1 Aya a relic during her Prime Resurgence, Rare Cerebrum, 1-day build

rows.label: Aya
rows.note: 1 per relic; bank it before the window opens

groups.activity: buy the Carrier Prime relics she stocks, 1 Aya each
groups.meta: only while Carrier Prime is in Prime Resurgence

live.text: vaulted; only during her Prime Resurgence

conditions: Her stock rotates away; relics and Aya you hold never expire.
bonuses: Varzia is also in the Market's Prime Resurgence tab.

rows.label: Carrier Prime Blueprint
rows.note: Lith V7 or Meso P12 or Meso V1 or Meso V3 or Meso V4 or Neo S3, Common: 25.33% Intact

rows.label: Carrier Prime Cerebrum
rows.note: Meso N3 or Meso V6, Uncommon: 20% Radiant; Lith C1 or Meso C1 or Meso C2 or Meso C7, Rare: 10% Radiant

rows.label: Carrier Prime Carapace
rows.note: Lith S5 or Neo A4 or Neo S1 or Axi N2, Common: 25.33% Intact; Lith V10, Uncommon: 20% Radiant

rows.label: Carrier Prime Systems
rows.note: Lith N2 or Lith S2 or Lith S3 or Neo A1 or Neo V3 or Axi A7 or Axi K12 or Axi V1, Common: 25.33% Intact

conditions: Refine Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each); leave Common relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds to 16.67%.
Mission rewards never drop Resurgence relics; Varzia is the only source.
bonuses: Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.

rows.label: Carrier Prime
rows.note: 15,000 cr, Cerebrum, Carapace, Systems, 6 Orokin Cell, 1 day

conditions: Claiming needs two free Companion slots: one for Carrier Prime and one for its Sweeper Prime.
